name: E-less Lipogram (Georges Perec)
description: Write without the most common letter in English: 'E'. Inspired by Georges Perec's novel 'A Void'.
descriptionBn: ইংরেজি ভাষার সবচেয়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত বর্ণ 'E' সম্পূর্ণ বাদ দিয়ে লিখুন।
sampleText: A stout wild wolf runs past our farm. Birds chirp high on dry hills, singing crisp songs without a sound of wind.

name: Smooth Flow (No T, No S)
description: Write without dental and sibilant sounds 'T' and 'S'. Creates a remarkably flowing, soft tone.
descriptionBn: T এবং S বর্ণ দুটি ছাড়া লিখুন। এটি লেখার গতিকে বিশেষ সুর দেয়।
sampleText: A cold rain fell on green loam, while my dog lay down by me and dreamed of joy.

name: Univocalic on E (Christian Bök)
description: The only permitted vowel is 'E'. All other vowels (A, I, O, U) are forbidden. Y is treated as a consonant.
descriptionBn: পুরো লেখায় শুধুমাত্র 'E' স্বরবর্ণ ব্যবহার করা যাবে। অন্য কোনো ভাওয়েল চলবে না।
sampleText: The green trees weep. Sweet breezes meet the deep red beets.

name: Univocalic on A
description: The only permitted vowel is 'A'. All other vowels (E, I, O, U) are forbidden.
descriptionBn: পুরো লেখায় শুধুমাত্র 'A' স্বরবর্ণ ব্যবহার করা যাবে।
sampleText: A tall man had a fast dark car. That man ran past a park as alarms rang.

name: Univocalic on O
description: The only permitted vowel is 'O'. All other vowels (A, E, I, U) are forbidden.
descriptionBn: পুরো লেখায় শুধুমাত্র 'O' স্বরবর্ণ ব্যবহার করা যাবে।
sampleText: Old Tom Fox got hot soup from Tom's pot on top of Cook's wood box.

name: Acrostic: AUTUMN
description: Each line of your verse must begin with the successive letters of the word 'AUTUMN'.
descriptionBn: প্রতিটি লাইনের প্রথম বর্ণ হবে যথাক্রমে A, U, T, U, M, N।
sampleText:
All golden leaves descend upon the ground,
Under cold gray skies of silent sound.
Time marches swiftly through the falling chill,
Unfolding whispers on the sleepy hill.
Mists gather slowly where the river gleams,
Night brings its quiet gift of peaceful dreams.

name: Drabble (Exactly 100 Words)
description: A complete narrative piece written in exactly 100 words. Not 99, not 101.
descriptionBn: ঠিক ১০০ শব্দের একটি সম্পূর্ণ ছোট গল্প বা অনুচ্ছেদ।
sampleText: The traveler opened the heavy brass door and stepped inside the ancient tower. Dust danced in the golden light cutting across tall wooden bookshelves. Centuries of forgotten records rested here, undisturbed by human hands since the Great Reckoning. He pulled a slim leather volume from the third shelf and brushed away the gray ash coating its title. The ink within still glowed with a faint azure brilliance, humming softly against his fingertips. At last, he had found the map showing where the lost sun had fallen. He placed it carefully inside his satchel and stepped back into the eternal night.

name: Mini-Saga (Exactly 50 Words)
description: A complete micro-story told in precisely 50 words.
sampleText: She watched the tiny green shoot break through dry cracked stone. No rain had touched this parched valley for forty long months. Yet here was life, fragile and stubborn, reaching upward toward the blazing morning sky. Smiling through her tears, she tipped the last remaining drops of canteen water onto its roots.

name: Tautogram on P
description: Every single word in the composition must start with the letter 'P'.
descriptionBn: প্রতিটি শব্দের শুরুর বর্ণ হতে হবে 'P'।
sampleText: Patient poets pen pretty prose passionately.

name: Monosyllabic Craft (One-Syllable Words)
description: Every word must contain exactly one syllable. Polysyllabic words are flagged.
descriptionBn: প্রতিটি শব্দ হতে হবে এক সিলেবলের (একাক্ষর)।
sampleText: The sun rose high and gave warm light to all the land as cold mist fled from the green grass.
